game.name: Super Robot Wars Xo (Japan)
game.desc: Adapted from Super Robot Wars GC, released at the time on Gamecube, this version named XO takes the basics inherent to one of the flagship sagas of tactical role-playing games, while bringing its share of new features. You'll find the greatest robots from the Japanese anime in fierce battles. This version incorporates the additions from the GC version, new characters, new scenarios and an Xbox Live mode for one-on-one online battles.
